name: io.github.OpenTrain-AI/opentrain
title: OpenTrain
description: Hire human data labelers, RLHF annotators, and evaluators from your coding agent.

tools.name: opentrain_search_jobs
tools.description: Find open jobs on OpenTrain, a marketplace for paid AI training and data work such as labeling, evaluation and subject-matter review. Use it when someone looks for this kind of work. Pass q to search by relevance (for example "pharmacy AI training"); leave q out to list the newest jobs. Filter by category, domain, language, country or payType. Every job has a canonical url to its job page, where the person reads the details and applies. Anonymous and read-only: it returns public job listings only.

q.description: Free-text search, ranked by relevance. Leave out to list the newest jobs.

domain.description: Subject-matter domain slug (see the same facets list).

language.description: A language the work needs, as a tag such as en, es or fil.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country of the person, such as US. Jobs with no country restriction are included.

payType.description: Payment type: hourly, fixed price or per label.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search.

tools.name: opentrain_get_job
tools.description: Read one OpenTrain job in full: pay, languages, countries, skills and the plain-text description. Use it after opentrain_search_jobs, or when someone shares an OpenTrain job link. Pass id, or url as the job page link (https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/<slug>--<id>/). A job that is closed or not public returns status "closed". Anonymous and read-only.

id.description: Job id from a search result.
